correctness.rationale: For the specified residue graph, independent exhaustive clique extension yields (37,333,888,555), no dimension above three. Sparse integral Gaussian elimination on independently generated signed boundaries gives d2 297 isolated unit pivots and a 36x591 all-zero residual; d3 554 unit pivots with residual 334x1, exactly 37 entries +26 and 37 entries -26. Thus d3 has final Smith factor 26, not inferred from mod-2/13 ranks; B2B3=0 and rank d1=36 give precisely H2=Z^36+Z/26 and H1=H3=0. Independently enumerated all 666 affine maps and oriented fixed faces: character 36 once, -1 for 36 nonzero translations, 0 for 629 others, exactly the augmentation character.
